principles: Resume must be evidence-led, not memory-led.
Committed done checkpoints may be trusted only through a replayable ledger/projection.
Interrupted steps are at-least-once; this story must not overclaim exactly-once execution.
M1 must not widen into provider health, throttling, process-pool, or remote production-proof semantics.
drivers: Current autopilot_resume hard-refuses healthy non-stale runs.
The red repro and spike prove a small ledger-backed recovery path is feasible.
Existing autopilot smoke and command policy must remain no-production-overclaim.

options.name: A: keep hard refusal and document it
cons: Does not fix the reproduced bug
Leaves autopilot_resume unusable for healthy interrupted runs

options.name: B: ledger-backed resume projection for M1
pros: Creates an auditable basis for later M2/M3/M4
cons: Requires updating result types, renderer, command descriptions, and smoke tests

options.name: C: restart dispatch/autopilot execution directly on resume
pros: Could feel more automatic to users
cons: Touches provider/ramp/process-pool concerns that are explicitly out of scope

chosen: B: ledger-backed resume projection for M1
rationale: Choose B because it directly turns the red repro green while preserving Proofbound evidence boundaries: healthy non-stale runs can resume from committed checkpoint facts, while stale or corrupt states still fail closed and no remote production proof is claimed.

preMortem.scenario: Resume falsely claims safe progress from stale state
preMortem.trigger: updatedAt or checkpoint material is older than allowed maxResumeAgeMs
preMortem.consequence: Autopilot may guide a user from outdated state
preMortem.mitigation: Keep stale_state refusal and add smoke coverage for stale records.

preMortem.scenario: Committed checkpoint replay overclaims exactly-once execution
preMortem.trigger: Interrupted step lacks committed done checkpoint but implementation marks it done
preMortem.consequence: A missed step could be skipped during resume
preMortem.mitigation: Only skip committed done checkpoints; interrupted or missing checkpoints remain pending/at-least-once.

preMortem.scenario: Command metadata still says resume refuses unsafe v1 runs
preMortem.trigger: Core behavior changes but command catalog/process fact wording is not updated
preMortem.consequence: Reviewers and gap scanners see implementation/documentation drift
preMortem.mitigation: Update command catalog, command policy and process fact wording with no-production-overclaim semantics.

preMortem.trigger: New resume status accidentally sets receiptVerified or productionDone true
preMortem.consequence: Resume becomes proof-looking metadata instead of local state guidance
preMortem.mitigation: Keep authorityChanged/receiptVerified/productionDone false in result and test both new smoke and existing autopilot-run smoke.
